Load packages:

```{r}
#| message: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(MetBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
```

File paths: 

```{r}
fp_cee = "~/../../Volumes/subseasonal_extreme/"
fp_res_test = "weekly_ave_test/Results/weekly_model_results_2021-2024/"
fp_rf = "RF/RF_Final_Code/outputs/"
fp_res_test_eesn = 
  "ML-methods-for-weather-forecasting-internal-dev/EESNs/results/"
```

Colors

```{r}
cols_models = met.brewer(name = "Egypt", n = 4, type = "discrete")
```

# Load Predictions

Load RF predictions:

```{r}
preds_rf <-
  read.csv(paste0(
    fp_cee,
    fp_res_test,
    fp_rf,
    "predictions_2021_2024_RF/RF_preds_standard_2021_2024.csv"
  )) |>
  rename_all(.funs = tolower) |>
  rename(
    date = forecast_date,
    obs = observed,
    pred_rf = predicted,
    pred_detrended_rf = pred_detrended
  ) |>
  separate(
    date, 
    into = c("year", "week"), 
    sep = 4, 
    remove = TRUE
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    week = as.numeric(week),
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week),
    extreme = ifelse(abs(z_score) >= 1, T, F)
  ) |>
  arrange(region, horizon, date) |>
  select(
    region, 
    horizon,
    date, 
    year, 
    week,
    obs,
    obs_detrended, 
    pred_rf, 
    pred_detrended_rf,
    z_score,
    extreme
  )
```

Load EESN predictions:

```{r}
preds_eesn <-
  read.csv(file = paste0(
    fp_cee, 
    fp_res_test_eesn,
    "final-preds-chosen-by-all-data.csv"
  )) |>
  rename(pred_detrended_eesn = pred) |>
  mutate(
    newyears = ymd(paste0(year,"-01-01")),
    date = newyears + weeks(week)
  ) |>
  filter(
    data != "training",
    year < 2025
  ) |>
  select(-data, -newyears) |>
  select(region, horizon, date, year, week, pred_detrended_eesn) |>
  arrange(region, horizon, date)
```

Join predictions: 

```{r}
preds <-
  full_join(
    preds_rf,
    preds_eesn,
    by = join_by(horizon, region, date, year, week)
  ) |>
  mutate(extreme = ifelse(extreme, "extreme", NA)) |>
  select(
    horizon,
    region,
    date,
    year,
    week,
    z_score,
    extreme,
    obs,
    obs_detrended,
    pred_rf,
    pred_detrended_rf,
    pred_detrended_eesn,
    everything()
  )
```

# Figures

## Observed and Predicted Over Time

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-width: 12
#| echo: false

preds_mw <-
  preds |> 
  filter(region == "MW") |>
  mutate(horizon = paste0("Horizon: ", horizon))

plot_preds_mw <-
  preds_mw |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = obs_detrended, color = 'Observed'),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = pred_detrended_eesn, color = "EESN Predictions"),
    linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(x = date, y = pred_detrended_rf, color = "RF Predictions"),
    linewidth = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = preds_mw |> filter(extreme == "extreme"), 
    aes(x = date, y = obs_detrended, color = "Observed extremes")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ horizon, nrow = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(2.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    breaks = c(
      "Observed",
      "RF Predictions",
      "EESN Predictions",
      "Observed extremes"
    ),
    values = c(
      "Observed" = "black",
      "RF Predictions" = cols_models[4],
      "EESN Predictions" = "dodgerblue",
      "Observed extremes" = "red3"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(        
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.15),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.15),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain"),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16),
    title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Region MW: Observed vs Predicted Time Series",
    x = 'Week',
    y = 'T2M residual'
  )

plot_preds_mw
```

## Observed vs Predicted

Function to make a single panel: 

```{r}
make_panel <- function(
    df, 
    show_x = FALSE, 
    show_y = FALSE, 
    title = NULL,
    xlab = NULL,
    ylab = NULL,
    right_lab = NULL
  ) {
  
  ggplot(
    data = df, 
    mapping = aes(x = s_obs, y = s_preds)
  ) +
    geom_point(col = "#1f77b4", alpha = 0.85, size = 0.75) +
    geom_abline(
      slope = 1, 
      intercept = 0, 
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(df$panel_min[1], df$panel_max[1]),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0),
      breaks = scales::breaks_width(5)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(df$panel_min[1], df$panel_max[1]),
      expand = expansion(mult = 0),
      breaks = scales::breaks_width(5),
      sec.axis = if (!is.null(right_lab)) dup_axis(name = right_lab) else waiver()
    ) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.15),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.15),
      axis.ticks.y = if (show_y)
        element_line(color = "black")
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = if (show_x)
        element_line(color = "black")
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      axis.text.x = if (show_x)
        element_text(color = "black", size = 8)
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = if (show_y)
        element_text(color = "black", size = 8)
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.text.y.right = element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = if (!is.null(xlab))
        element_text(color = "black", size = 12)
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.title.y.left = if (!is.null(ylab))
        element_text(color = "black", size = 12)
      else
        element_blank(),
      axis.title.y.right = if (!is.null(right_lab))
        element_text(size = 12, angle = 90)
      else
        element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 1
      ),
      plot.margin = margin(
        t = 4,
        r = 0,
        b = 4,
        l = 0
      )
    )
}
```

Prepare data for plots (RF):

```{r}
## Prepare qq data for plot
qq_plot_data_rf <-
  preds |>
  summarise(
    s_preds = list(sort(pred_detrended_rf)),
    s_obs = list(sort(obs_detrended)),
    .by = c(horizon, region)
  ) |>
  unnest(c(s_preds, s_obs)) |>
  mutate(
    horizon = factor(paste0("H=", horizon), levels = paste0("H=", 1:4))
  )

## Ranges for each panel
panel_ranges_rf <- 
  qq_plot_data_rf |>
  group_by(region, horizon) |>
  summarise(
    panel_min = min(c(s_obs, s_preds), na.rm = TRUE),
    panel_max = max(c(s_obs, s_preds), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    span = panel_max - panel_min,
    pad = if_else(span > 0, 0.04 * span, 0.04),
    panel_min = panel_min - pad,
    panel_max = panel_max + pad
  )

## Join ranges with data
qq_plot_data_rf <- 
  qq_plot_data_rf |>
  left_join(panel_ranges_rf, by = c("region", "horizon"))
```

Create RF plot:

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12
#| message: false

## Build Each Row by horizon and region
regions <- unique(qq_plot_data_rf$region)
horizons <- unique(qq_plot_data_rf$horizon)

## Data rows
row_plots <- list()
for (r in seq_along(regions)) {
  row_items <- list()

  for (h in seq_along(horizons)) {
    
    df_panel <- 
      qq_plot_data_rf |>
      filter(region == regions[r], horizon == horizons[h])
    
    #print(paste0('Region: ', regions[r], ' ', horizons[h]))
    row_items[[h]] <- make_panel(
      df_panel,
      show_x = TRUE,
      show_y = TRUE,
      title = if (regions[r] == 'MW') horizons[h] else NULL,
      xlab = if (regions[r] == 'W') "Observed" else NULL,
      ylab = if (horizons[h] == 'H=1') regions[r] else NULL,
      right_lab = if (horizons[h] == 'H=4') "Predicted" else NULL
      
    )
  }
  
  row_plots[[r]] <- wrap_plots(
    row_items,
    ncol = length(horizons),
    widths = rep(1, length(horizons))
  )
  
}

## Combine all rows
full_plot <- wrap_plots(
  row_plots,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = rep(1, length(regions))
)

## Create plot
QQ_RF <- (
  full_plot &
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)))

QQ_RF
```

Create EESN plot:

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12
#| message: false

## Build Each Row by horizon and region
regions <- unique(qq_plot_data_eesn$region)
horizons <- unique(qq_plot_data_eesn$horizon)

## Data rows
row_plots <- list()
for (r in seq_along(regions)) {
  row_items <- list()

  for (h in seq_along(horizons)) {
    df_panel <- qq_plot_data_eesn |>
      filter(region == regions[r], horizon == horizons[h])
    
    #print(paste0('Region: ', regions[r], ' ', horizons[h]))
    row_items[[h]] <- make_panel(
      df_panel,
      show_x = TRUE,
      show_y = TRUE,
      title = if (regions[r] == 'MW') horizons[h] else NULL,
      xlab = if (regions[r] == 'W') "Observed" else NULL,
      ylab = if (horizons[h] == 'H=1') regions[r] else NULL,
      right_lab = if (horizons[h] == 'H=4') "Predicted" else NULL
      
    )
  }
  
  row_plots[[r]] <- wrap_plots(
    row_items,
    ncol = length(horizons),
    widths = rep(1, length(horizons))
  )
  
}

## Combine all rows
full_plot <- wrap_plots(
  row_plots,
  ncol = 1,
  heights = rep(1, length(regions))
)

## Create plot
QQ_EESN <- (
  full_plot &
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)))

QQ_EESN
```
